subject.title: fix: stop doctor misreporting trusted-proxy gateways as unauthenticated

question: Should Doctor downgrade the exposed-Gateway finding to trusted-proxy warning guidance only when the configuration passes Gateway startup validation and a synthetic request passes the real trusted-proxy authorizer?
rationale: This does not alter runtime authentication, but it changes the severity and remediation operators receive for an exposed security boundary; maintainers must explicitly accept that diagnostic policy.

options.title: Accept runtime-aligned classification
options.body: After rebase, fresh proof, and checks, merge the patch so valid documented trusted-proxy deployments receive targeted firewall guidance rather than an inaccurate unauthenticated critical.

options.title: Keep the generic critical
options.body: Retain current Doctor behavior if maintainers want every non-shared-secret exposed bind to remain critical regardless of valid trusted-proxy configuration.

recommendation.title: Accept runtime-aligned classification
recommendation.body: After rebase, fresh proof, and checks, merge the patch so valid documented trusted-proxy deployments receive targeted firewall guidance rather than an inaccurate unauthenticated critical.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent security and Doctor-area history makes steipete the strongest available routing candidate for the classification policy.
